subject: humanities
passage: Fanny Mendelssohn, the older sister of the composer Felix Mendelssohn, was praised by many who heard her as an exceptional pianist, and she wrote more than 450 pieces of music, from short songs to a string quartet and a piano cycle depicting the months of the year. Although several of her early songs were printed under her brother's name and she published only a handful of works under her own before her death in ______ music has been widely performed and recorded since the late twentieth century.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The sentence begins with "Although," so everything up to "her death in 1847" is one long dependent clause. It needs to be joined to the main clause, "her music has been widely performed and recorded," with a comma. The dependent clause already shows the contrast, so no other conjunction is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon must join two independent clauses, but the "Although" clause is dependent.
explanation.B: Correct. A comma correctly links the long introductory "Although" clause to the main clause.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Although" already links the two parts of the sentence, so adding "but" leaves the sentence with two conjunctions doing one job, and no main clause stands on its own.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A period would leave "Although several of her early songs ... in 1847" as a sentence fragment.
